@unittest.skipUnless(
    _HARBOR_YML.exists(), "bench-harbor.yml not found (standalone bench checkout)"

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1]
        block = block.split("\n      ", 3)[0:3]
        joined = "\n      ".join(block)
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", joined)
        self.assertIn("default: false", joined)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class RunOutcomeClassTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1643 C4: run() stashes the terminal outcome class for
    populate_context_post_run — every terminal outcome maps to exactly one
    of agent_timeout (self-kill at cap) / external_kill / completed /
    crashed; never-started has no run() at all and defaults in the context
    fold (metadata failure_mode = 'never_started').
    """

    def setUp(self):
        self._env = _clean_env(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="1",
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
        )
        self._env.start()
        self.addCleanup(self._env.stop)

    def _knobs(self):
        return fa_agent_timeout.TimeoutKnobs.from_env()

    def test_self_kill_maps_to_agent_timeout(self):
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
            asyncio.run(agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object()))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "agent_timeout")

    def test_natural_completion_maps_to_completed(self):
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        # A fast poll: the exec finishes before the first evaluate, so the
        # loop exits at its done() check (completed) — the 1s flat cap
        # never fires.
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            asyncio.run(agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object()))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")

    def test_crashed_exec_maps_to_crashed(self):
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_error=RuntimeError("fa died"))
        # Same shape, 30s cap: the exec task itself raises.
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05), mock.patch.dict(
            os.environ, {"FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC": "30"}
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent._run_with_deadline(
                        fa_agent_timeout.TimeoutKnobs.from_env(),
                        "task",
                        object(),
                    )
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "crashed")

    def test_cancelled_run_maps_to_external_kill(self):
        agent = FakeAgent()

        async def scenario():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object())
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            task.cancel()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task

        asyncio.run(scenario())
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "external_kill")

    def test_no_cap_plain_exec_maps_to_completed(self):
        env = _clean_env(
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
        )
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        asyncio.run(agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")

{"newText":"    # ── gh-1681 Gap 2: ATIF trajectory export ─────────────────────────────

    async def _export_atif_trajectory(self, environment) -> None:
        """Best-effort ATIF export to /logs/agent/trajectory.json.

        Harbor's upload packager stores that file as the trial's
        trajectory_path and the leaderboard static analysis rejects
        rewarded trials without one; harbor does not build it for
        installed agents. The export rides the in-container fa CLI (the
        whole-snapshot exporter in lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart via
        `fa trajectory export`), so the conversion logic lives in ONE
        place (Dart) and the raw session JSONL stays the only input.

        Never raises: a failed/wedged export degrades to a loud stderr
        warning and populate_context_post_run's atif_trajectory metadata
        records the miss — the trial's own outcome is untouched.
        """
        command = (
            f"fa --session-root {_SESSION_ROOT} trajectory export "
            "--format atif --output /logs/agent/trajectory.json"
        )
        try:
            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self.exec_as_agent(
                    environment, command=command,
                    timeout_sec=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC,
                ),
                timeout=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC + 15,
            )
            if result.return_code != 0:
                tail = (result.stdout or "")[-200:]
                print(
                    f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export exited "
                    f"{result.return_code} (leaderboard static analysis "
                    f"needs agent/trajectory.json): {tail}",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                    flush=True,
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(
                f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export failed "
                f"(leaderboard static analysis needs agent/trajectory.json): "
                f"{exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
                flush=True,
            )

class AtifExportTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681 Gap 2: run() exports the ATIF trajectory on EVERY terminal
    path (completion / self-kill / crash / external cancel) via a bounded
    best-effort exec — the leaderboard static analysis requires
    <trial>/agent/trajectory.json on every rewarded trial and harbor does
    not build it for installed agents. Export failures degrade to a loud
    warning and the atif_trajectory metadata, never masking the trial's
    own outcome.
    """

    def _knob_env(self, **overrides):
        env = _clean_env(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="1",
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
            **overrides,
        )
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)

    def _export_calls(self, agent):
        return [c for c in agent.agent_calls if "trajectory export" in c]

    def test_completion_path_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            asyncio.run(agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        exports = self._export_calls(agent)
        self.assertEqual(len(exports), 1, agent.agent_calls)
        self.assertIn(_EXPORT_SNIPPET, exports[0])
        # The export names the session root the launch command uses.
        self.assertIn("fa --session-root /logs/agent/fah-sessions", exports[0])

    def test_self_kill_timeout_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with mock.patch.object(
            fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressWatch", _FastWatch
        ), mock.patch.object(fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressLadder", _FastWatch):
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "agent_timeout")
        # The kill lands BEFORE the export (the trajectory must reflect
        # the final ledger, not a live one).
        kill_idx = next(
            i for i, c in enumerate(agent.root_calls) if "pkill" in c
        )
        launch_kinds = [
            ("agent", c) for c in agent.agent_calls
        ] + [("root", c) for c in agent.root_calls]
        last_kill_order = max(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds) if "pkill" in c
        )
        export_order = next(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds)
            if "trajectory export" in c
        )
        self.assertGreater(export_order, last_kill_order)
        self.assertIsNotNone(kill_idx)

    def test_external_cancel_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()

        async def scenario():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            task.cancel()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task

        asyncio.run(scenario())
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "external_kill")
        self.assertEqual(len(self._export_calls(agent)), 1)

    def test_export_failure_is_loud_but_never_fails_the_trial(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(
            launch_delay=0.05, export_error=RuntimeError("fa export wedged")
        )
        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export failed", err.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("leaderboard static analysis", err.getvalue())

    def test_export_nonzero_exit_warns(self):
        self._knob_env()

        class _FailedResult:
            return_code = 3
            stdout = "boom"

        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        real_exec = agent.exec_as_agent

        async def scripted(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            if "trajectory export" in command:
                return _FailedResult()
            return await real_exec(environment, command=command, env=env,

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""gh-1681 Gap 2 — the ATIF fixture contract, validated from the harbor side.

`bench/harbor_fa/fixtures/atif_sample.json` is the GOLDEN output of the
Dart exporter (`lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart`, pinned by
test/trajectory/atif_export_test.dart). This test loads the same bytes and
validates them against the REAL harbor 0.23.0 trajectory stack — the
pydantic `Trajectory` model and the static-analysis
`validate_trajectory` gate — so a schema drift on either side fails the
bench-script gate the workflows run (bench-tests.yml installs the pinned
harbor; the test skips when harbor is not importable, e.g. a bare dev
box).

Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s bench/harbor_fa
"""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

_FIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / "atif_sample.json"

try:
    from harbor.models.trajectories.trajectory import Trajectory
    from harbor.utils.trajectory_validator import validate_trajectory

    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised on bare dev boxes
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = False


@unittest.skipUnless(
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE,
    "harbor not importable (install 'harbor[modal]==0.23.0' as the "
    "bench workflows do)",
)
class AtifFixtureContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The Dart exporter's golden output must satisfy harbor's model and
    the leaderboard-style static validator."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.data = json.loads(_FIXTURE.read_text())

    def test_fixture_parses_as_atif_trajectory(self):
        trajectory = Trajectory(**self.data)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.schema_version, "ATIF-v1.7")
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.agent.name, "fa")
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.steps), 7)
        # Step ids are sequential from 1 (the model enforces it too).
        self.assertEqual(
            [s.step_id for s in trajectory.steps], list(range(1, 8))
        )

    def test_fixture_passes_the_static_analysis_validator(self):
        self.assertTrue(validate_trajectory(self.data))

    def test_tool_steps_are_deterministic_dispatches(self):
        tool_steps = [
            s for s in self.data["steps"] if "tool_calls" in s
        ]
        self.assertTrue(tool_steps)
        for step in tool_steps:
            self.assertEqual(step["llm_call_count"], 0)
            self.assertNotIn("metrics", step)
            self.assertNotIn("reasoning_content", step)
            self.assertIn("message", step)  # required on every step

    def test_non_agent_steps_carry_no_agent_only_fields(self):
        for step in self.data["steps"]:
            if step["source"] == "agent":
                continue
            for key in (
                "model_name",
                "metrics",
                "tool_calls",
                "reasoning_content",
                "llm_call_count",
            ):
                self.assertNotIn(key, step, f"{key} on {step['source']} step")

    def test_final_metrics_totals_match_the_steps(self):
        metrics = self.data["final_metrics"]
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_steps"], len(self.data["steps"]))
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_prompt_tokens"], 100)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_completion_tokens"], 20)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_cached_tokens"], 30)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1]
        block = block.split("\n      ", 3)[0:3]
        joined = "\n      ".join(block)
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", joined)
        self.assertIn("default: false", joined)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.

        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class RunOutcomeClassTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1643 C4: run() stashes the terminal outcome class for
    populate_context_post_run — every terminal outcome maps to exactly one
    of agent_timeout (self-kill at cap) / external_kill / completed /
    crashed; never-started has no run() at all and defaults in the context
    fold (metadata failure_mode = 'never_started').
    """

    def setUp(self):
        self._env = _clean_env(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="1",
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
        )
        self._env.start()
        self.addCleanup(self._env.stop)

    def _knobs(self):
        return fa_agent_timeout.TimeoutKnobs.from_env()

    def test_self_kill_maps_to_agent_timeout(self):
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
            asyncio.run(agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object()))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "agent_timeout")

    def test_natural_completion_maps_to_completed(self):
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        # A fast poll: the exec finishes before the first evaluate, so the
        # loop exits at its done() check (completed) — the 1s flat cap
        # never fires.
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            asyncio.run(agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object()))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")

    def test_crashed_exec_maps_to_crashed(self):
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_error=RuntimeError("fa died"))
        # Same shape, 30s cap: the exec task itself raises.
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05), mock.patch.dict(
            os.environ, {"FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC": "30"}
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent._run_with_deadline(
                        fa_agent_timeout.TimeoutKnobs.from_env(),
                        "task",
                        object(),
                    )
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "crashed")

    def test_cancelled_run_maps_to_external_kill(self):
        agent = FakeAgent()

        async def scenario():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object())
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            task.cancel()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task

        asyncio.run(scenario())
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "external_kill")

    def test_no_cap_plain_exec_maps_to_completed(self):
        env = _clean_env(
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
        )
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        asyncio.run(agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")

{"newText":"    # ── gh-1681 Gap 2: ATIF trajectory export ─────────────────────────────

    async def _export_atif_trajectory(self, environment) -> None:
        """Best-effort ATIF export to /logs/agent/trajectory.json.

        Harbor's upload packager stores that file as the trial's
        trajectory_path and the leaderboard static analysis rejects
        rewarded trials without one; harbor does not build it for
        installed agents. The export rides the in-container fa CLI (the
        whole-snapshot exporter in lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart via
        `fa trajectory export`), so the conversion logic lives in ONE
        place (Dart) and the raw session JSONL stays the only input.

        Never raises: a failed/wedged export degrades to a loud stderr
        warning and populate_context_post_run's atif_trajectory metadata
        records the miss — the trial's own outcome is untouched.
        """
        command = (
            f"fa --session-root {_SESSION_ROOT} trajectory export "
            "--format atif --output /logs/agent/trajectory.json"
        )
        try:
            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self.exec_as_agent(
                    environment, command=command,
                    timeout_sec=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC,
                ),
                timeout=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC + 15,
            )
            if result.return_code != 0:
                tail = (result.stdout or "")[-200:]
                print(
                    f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export exited "
                    f"{result.return_code} (leaderboard static analysis "
                    f"needs agent/trajectory.json): {tail}",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                    flush=True,
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(
                f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export failed "
                f"(leaderboard static analysis needs agent/trajectory.json): "
                f"{exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
                flush=True,
            )

class AtifExportTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681 Gap 2: run() exports the ATIF trajectory on EVERY terminal
    path (completion / self-kill / crash / external cancel) via a bounded
    best-effort exec — the leaderboard static analysis requires
    <trial>/agent/trajectory.json on every rewarded trial and harbor does
    not build it for installed agents. Export failures degrade to a loud
    warning and the atif_trajectory metadata, never masking the trial's
    own outcome.
    """

    def _knob_env(self, **overrides):
        env = _clean_env(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="1",
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
            **overrides,
        )
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)

    def _export_calls(self, agent):
        return [c for c in agent.agent_calls if "trajectory export" in c]

    def test_completion_path_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            asyncio.run(agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        exports = self._export_calls(agent)
        self.assertEqual(len(exports), 1, agent.agent_calls)
        self.assertIn(_EXPORT_SNIPPET, exports[0])
        # The export names the session root the launch command uses.
        self.assertIn("fa --session-root /logs/agent/fah-sessions", exports[0])

    def test_self_kill_timeout_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with mock.patch.object(
            fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressWatch", _FastWatch
        ), mock.patch.object(fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressLadder", _FastWatch):
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "agent_timeout")
        # The kill lands BEFORE the export (the trajectory must reflect
        # the final ledger, not a live one).
        kill_idx = next(
            i for i, c in enumerate(agent.root_calls) if "pkill" in c
        )
        launch_kinds = [
            ("agent", c) for c in agent.agent_calls
        ] + [("root", c) for c in agent.root_calls]
        last_kill_order = max(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds) if "pkill" in c
        )
        export_order = next(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds)
            if "trajectory export" in c
        )
        self.assertGreater(export_order, last_kill_order)
        self.assertIsNotNone(kill_idx)

    def test_external_cancel_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()

        async def scenario():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            task.cancel()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task

        asyncio.run(scenario())
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "external_kill")
        self.assertEqual(len(self._export_calls(agent)), 1)

    def test_export_failure_is_loud_but_never_fails_the_trial(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(
            launch_delay=0.05, export_error=RuntimeError("fa export wedged")
        )
        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export failed", err.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("leaderboard static analysis", err.getvalue())

    def test_export_nonzero_exit_warns(self):
        self._knob_env()

        class _FailedResult:
            return_code = 3
            stdout = "boom"

        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        real_exec = agent.exec_as_agent

        async def scripted(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            if "trajectory export" in command:
                return _FailedResult()
            return await real_exec(environment, command=command, env=env,
                                   timeout_sec=timeout_sec)

        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), mock.patch.object(
                agent, "exec_as_agent", side_effect=scripted,
                autospec=True,
            ):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export exited 3", err.getvalue())

    def test_populate_context_marks_atif_trajectory_presence(self):
        import tempfile

        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            agent.logs_dir = Path(tmp)

            agent.populate_context_post_run(context2)
            self.assertEqual(
                context2.metadata["atif_trajectory"], "present"
            )
            # The failure-mode fold is untouched by the new flag.
            self.assertEqual(
                context2.metadata["failure_mode"], "never_started"
            )

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""gh-1681 Gap 2 — the ATIF fixture contract, validated from the harbor side.

`bench/harbor_fa/fixtures/atif_sample.json` is the GOLDEN output of the
Dart exporter (`lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart`, pinned by
test/trajectory/atif_export_test.dart). This test loads the same bytes and
validates them against the REAL harbor 0.23.0 trajectory stack — the
pydantic `Trajectory` model and the static-analysis
`validate_trajectory` gate — so a schema drift on either side fails the
bench-script gate the workflows run (bench-tests.yml installs the pinned
harbor; the test skips when harbor is not importable, e.g. a bare dev
box).

Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s bench/harbor_fa
"""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

_FIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / "atif_sample.json"

try:
    from harbor.models.trajectories.trajectory import Trajectory
    from harbor.utils.trajectory_validator import validate_trajectory

    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised on bare dev boxes
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = False


@unittest.skipUnless(
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE,
    "harbor not importable (install 'harbor[modal]==0.23.0' as the "
    "bench workflows do)",
)
class AtifFixtureContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The Dart exporter's golden output must satisfy harbor's model and
    the leaderboard-style static validator."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.data = json.loads(_FIXTURE.read_text())

    def test_fixture_parses_as_atif_trajectory(self):
        trajectory = Trajectory(**self.data)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.schema_version, "ATIF-v1.7")
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.agent.name, "fa")
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.steps), 7)
        # Step ids are sequential from 1 (the model enforces it too).
        self.assertEqual(
            [s.step_id for s in trajectory.steps], list(range(1, 8))
        )

    def test_fixture_passes_the_static_analysis_validator(self):
        self.assertTrue(validate_trajectory(self.data))

    def test_tool_steps_are_deterministic_dispatches(self):
        tool_steps = [
            s for s in self.data["steps"] if "tool_calls" in s
        ]
        self.assertTrue(tool_steps)
        for step in tool_steps:
            self.assertEqual(step["llm_call_count"], 0)
            self.assertNotIn("metrics", step)
            self.assertNotIn("reasoning_content", step)
            self.assertIn("message", step)  # required on every step

    def test_non_agent_steps_carry_no_agent_only_fields(self):
        for step in self.data["steps"]:
            if step["source"] == "agent":
                continue
            for key in (
                "model_name",
                "metrics",
                "tool_calls",
                "reasoning_content",
                "llm_call_count",
            ):
                self.assertNotIn(key, step, f"{key} on {step['source']} step")

    def test_final_metrics_totals_match_the_steps(self):
        metrics = self.data["final_metrics"]
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_steps"], len(self.data["steps"]))
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_prompt_tokens"], 100)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_completion_tokens"], 20)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_cached_tokens"], 30)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1]
        block = block.split("\n      ", 3)[0:3]
        joined = "\n      ".join(block)
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", joined)
        self.assertIn("default: false", joined)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

class RunOutcomeClassTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1643 C4: run() stashes the terminal outcome class for
    populate_context_post_run — every terminal outcome maps to exactly one
    of agent_timeout (self-kill at cap) / external_kill / completed /
    crashed; never-started has no run() at all and defaults in the context
    fold (metadata failure_mode = 'never_started').
    """

    def setUp(self):
        self._env = _clean_env(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="1",
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
        )
        self._env.start()
        self.addCleanup(self._env.stop)

    def _knobs(self):
        return fa_agent_timeout.TimeoutKnobs.from_env()

    def test_self_kill_maps_to_agent_timeout(self):
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
            asyncio.run(agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object()))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "agent_timeout")

    def test_natural_completion_maps_to_completed(self):
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        # A fast poll: the exec finishes before the first evaluate, so the
        # loop exits at its done() check (completed) — the 1s flat cap
        # never fires.
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            asyncio.run(agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object()))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")

    def test_crashed_exec_maps_to_crashed(self):
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_error=RuntimeError("fa died"))
        # Same shape, 30s cap: the exec task itself raises.
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05), mock.patch.dict(
            os.environ, {"FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC": "30"}
        ):
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent._run_with_deadline(
                        fa_agent_timeout.TimeoutKnobs.from_env(),
                        "task",
                        object(),
                    )
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "crashed")

    def test_cancelled_run_maps_to_external_kill(self):
        agent = FakeAgent()

        async def scenario():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                agent._run_with_deadline(self._knobs(), "task", object())
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            task.cancel()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task

        asyncio.run(scenario())
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "external_kill")

    def test_no_cap_plain_exec_maps_to_completed(self):
        env = _clean_env(
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
        )
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        asyncio.run(agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")

{"newText":"    # ── gh-1681 Gap 2: ATIF trajectory export ─────────────────────────────

    async def _export_atif_trajectory(self, environment) -> None:
        """Best-effort ATIF export to /logs/agent/trajectory.json.

        Harbor's upload packager stores that file as the trial's
        trajectory_path and the leaderboard static analysis rejects
        rewarded trials without one; harbor does not build it for
        installed agents. The export rides the in-container fa CLI (the
        whole-snapshot exporter in lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart via
        `fa trajectory export`), so the conversion logic lives in ONE
        place (Dart) and the raw session JSONL stays the only input.

        Never raises: a failed/wedged export degrades to a loud stderr
        warning and populate_context_post_run's atif_trajectory metadata
        records the miss — the trial's own outcome is untouched.
        """
        command = (
            f"fa --session-root {_SESSION_ROOT} trajectory export "
            "--format atif --output /logs/agent/trajectory.json"
        )
        try:
            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self.exec_as_agent(
                    environment, command=command,
                    timeout_sec=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC,
                ),
                timeout=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC + 15,
            )
            if result.return_code != 0:
                tail = (result.stdout or "")[-200:]
                print(
                    f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export exited "
                    f"{result.return_code} (leaderboard static analysis "
                    f"needs agent/trajectory.json): {tail}",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                    flush=True,
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(
                f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export failed "
                f"(leaderboard static analysis needs agent/trajectory.json): "
                f"{exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
                flush=True,
            )

class AtifExportTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681 Gap 2: run() exports the ATIF trajectory on EVERY terminal
    path (completion / self-kill / crash / external cancel) via a bounded
    best-effort exec — the leaderboard static analysis requires
    <trial>/agent/trajectory.json on every rewarded trial and harbor does
    not build it for installed agents. Export failures degrade to a loud
    warning and the atif_trajectory metadata, never masking the trial's
    own outcome.
    """

    def _knob_env(self, **overrides):
        env = _clean_env(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="1",
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
            **overrides,
        )
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)

    def _export_calls(self, agent):
        return [c for c in agent.agent_calls if "trajectory export" in c]

    def test_completion_path_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            asyncio.run(agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        exports = self._export_calls(agent)
        self.assertEqual(len(exports), 1, agent.agent_calls)
        self.assertIn(_EXPORT_SNIPPET, exports[0])
        # The export names the session root the launch command uses.
        self.assertIn("fa --session-root /logs/agent/fah-sessions", exports[0])

    def test_self_kill_timeout_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with mock.patch.object(
            fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressWatch", _FastWatch
        ), mock.patch.object(fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressLadder", _FastWatch):
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "agent_timeout")
        # The kill lands BEFORE the export (the trajectory must reflect
        # the final ledger, not a live one).
        kill_idx = next(
            i for i, c in enumerate(agent.root_calls) if "pkill" in c
        )
        launch_kinds = [
            ("agent", c) for c in agent.agent_calls
        ] + [("root", c) for c in agent.root_calls]
        last_kill_order = max(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds) if "pkill" in c
        )
        export_order = next(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds)
            if "trajectory export" in c
        )
        self.assertGreater(export_order, last_kill_order)
        self.assertIsNotNone(kill_idx)

    def test_external_cancel_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()

        async def scenario():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            task.cancel()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task

        asyncio.run(scenario())
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "external_kill")
        self.assertEqual(len(self._export_calls(agent)), 1)

    def test_export_failure_is_loud_but_never_fails_the_trial(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(
            launch_delay=0.05, export_error=RuntimeError("fa export wedged")
        )
        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export failed", err.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("leaderboard static analysis", err.getvalue())

    def test_export_nonzero_exit_warns(self):
        self._knob_env()

        class _FailedResult:
            return_code = 3
            stdout = "boom"

        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        real_exec = agent.exec_as_agent

        async def scripted(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            if "trajectory export" in command:
                return _FailedResult()
            return await real_exec(environment, command=command, env=env,
                                   timeout_sec=timeout_sec)

        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), mock.patch.object(
                agent, "exec_as_agent", side_effect=scripted,
                autospec=True,
            ):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export exited 3", err.getvalue())

    def test_populate_context_marks_atif_trajectory_presence(self):
        import tempfile

        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            agent.logs_dir = Path(tmp)
            (Path(tmp) / "fah-sessions").mkdir()
            context = types.SimpleNamespace(metadata=None)
            agent.populate_context_post_run(context)
            self.assertEqual(
                context.metadata["atif_trajectory"], "missing"
            )
            (Path(tmp) / "trajectory.json").write_text("{}")
            context2 = types.SimpleNamespace(metadata=None)
            agent.populate_context_post_run(context2)
            self.assertEqual(
                context2.metadata["atif_trajectory"], "present"
            )
            # The failure-mode fold is untouched by the new flag.
            self.assertEqual(
                context2.metadata["failure_mode"], "never_started"
            )

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""gh-1681 Gap 2 — the ATIF fixture contract, validated from the harbor side.

`bench/harbor_fa/fixtures/atif_sample.json` is the GOLDEN output of the
Dart exporter (`lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart`, pinned by
test/trajectory/atif_export_test.dart). This test loads the same bytes and
validates them against the REAL harbor 0.23.0 trajectory stack — the
pydantic `Trajectory` model and the static-analysis
`validate_trajectory` gate — so a schema drift on either side fails the
bench-script gate the workflows run (bench-tests.yml installs the pinned
harbor; the test skips when harbor is not importable, e.g. a bare dev
box).

Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s bench/harbor_fa
"""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

_FIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / "atif_sample.json"

try:
    from harbor.models.trajectories.trajectory import Trajectory
    from harbor.utils.trajectory_validator import validate_trajectory

    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised on bare dev boxes
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = False


@unittest.skipUnless(
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE,
    "harbor not importable (install 'harbor[modal]==0.23.0' as the "
    "bench workflows do)",
)
class AtifFixtureContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The Dart exporter's golden output must satisfy harbor's model and
    the leaderboard-style static validator."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.data = json.loads(_FIXTURE.read_text())

    def test_fixture_parses_as_atif_trajectory(self):
        trajectory = Trajectory(**self.data)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.schema_version, "ATIF-v1.7")
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.agent.name, "fa")
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.steps), 7)
        # Step ids are sequential from 1 (the model enforces it too).
        self.assertEqual(
            [s.step_id for s in trajectory.steps], list(range(1, 8))
        )

    def test_fixture_passes_the_static_analysis_validator(self):
        self.assertTrue(validate_trajectory(self.data))

    def test_tool_steps_are_deterministic_dispatches(self):
        tool_steps = [
            s for s in self.data["steps"] if "tool_calls" in s
        ]
        self.assertTrue(tool_steps)
        for step in tool_steps:
            self.assertEqual(step["llm_call_count"], 0)
            self.assertNotIn("metrics", step)
            self.assertNotIn("reasoning_content", step)
            self.assertIn("message", step)  # required on every step

    def test_non_agent_steps_carry_no_agent_only_fields(self):
        for step in self.data["steps"]:
            if step["source"] == "agent":
                continue
            for key in (
                "model_name",
                "metrics",
                "tool_calls",
                "reasoning_content",
                "llm_call_count",
            ):
                self.assertNotIn(key, step, f"{key} on {step['source']} step")

    def test_final_metrics_totals_match_the_steps(self):
        metrics = self.data["final_metrics"]
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_steps"], len(self.data["steps"]))
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_prompt_tokens"], 100)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_completion_tokens"], 20)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_cached_tokens"], 30)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"newText":"      # gh-1681 Gap 2: the leaderboard static analysis requires an ATIF
      # trajectory (agent/trajectory.json) on every rewarded trial — the
      # fa adapter exports one per trial after the agent phase. Gate the
      # upload on their presence: warn-only in normal runs (upload stays
      # best-effort), hard failure in submission mode (an un-submittable
      # job must not burn hub quota either). The scan covers this shard's
      # pinned job dir only; the zero-trial retry's preserved attempt-1
      # dir (_attempt1-*) is a sibling and never matches.
      - name: Preflight ATIF trajectories
        if: always()
        env:
          ENV_TYPE: ${{ matrix.env }}
          KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.i }}
          SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}
          # FAMILY rides the bench job's env block (see the harbor run
          # step's DATASET note — no steps.* refs across jobs).
          JOB_NAME: fa-${{ needs.setup.outputs.family }}-${{ matrix.env }}-${{ matrix.kind }}-${{ matrix.i }}
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          total=0
          missing=0
          for result in "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/bench/jobs/${JOB_NAME}"/*/result.json; do
            total=$((total + 1))
            trial_dir=$(dirname "$result")
            if [ ! -f "$trial_dir/agent/trajectory.json" ]; then
              missing=$((missing + 1))
              echo "::warning::trial $(basename "$trial_dir") has result.json but no agent/trajectory.json (ATIF) — the leaderboard static analysis fails such trials (gh-1681)"
            fi
          done
          {
            echo "## ATIF trajectories (shard ${JOB_NAME})"
            echo
            echo "$((total - missing))/$total trials carry an ATIF trajectory."
          } >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-/dev/null}"
          if [ "$SUBMISSION" = "true" ] && [ "$missing" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::submission mode: $missing of $total trials lack agent/trajectory.json — a submission job must contain zero trials missing an ATIF trajectory"

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1]
        block = block.split("\n      ", 3)[0:3]
        joined = "\n      ".join(block)
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", joined)
        self.assertIn("default: false", joined)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

{"newText":"    # ── gh-1681 Gap 2: ATIF trajectory export ─────────────────────────────

    async def _export_atif_trajectory(self, environment) -> None:
        """Best-effort ATIF export to /logs/agent/trajectory.json.

        Harbor's upload packager stores that file as the trial's
        trajectory_path and the leaderboard static analysis rejects
        rewarded trials without one; harbor does not build it for
        installed agents. The export rides the in-container fa CLI (the
        whole-snapshot exporter in lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart via
        `fa trajectory export`), so the conversion logic lives in ONE
        place (Dart) and the raw session JSONL stays the only input.

        Never raises: a failed/wedged export degrades to a loud stderr
        warning and populate_context_post_run's atif_trajectory metadata
        records the miss — the trial's own outcome is untouched.
        """
        command = (
            f"fa --session-root {_SESSION_ROOT} trajectory export "
            "--format atif --output /logs/agent/trajectory.json"
        )
        try:
            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self.exec_as_agent(
                    environment, command=command,
                    timeout_sec=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC,
                ),
                timeout=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC + 15,
            )
            if result.return_code != 0:
                tail = (result.stdout or "")[-200:]
                print(
                    f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export exited "
                    f"{result.return_code} (leaderboard static analysis "
                    f"needs agent/trajectory.json): {tail}",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                    flush=True,
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(
                f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export failed "
                f"(leaderboard static analysis needs agent/trajectory.json): "
                f"{exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
                flush=True,
            )

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""gh-1681 Gap 2 — the ATIF fixture contract, validated from the harbor side.

`bench/harbor_fa/fixtures/atif_sample.json` is the GOLDEN output of the
Dart exporter (`lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart`, pinned by
test/trajectory/atif_export_test.dart). This test loads the same bytes and
validates them against the REAL harbor 0.23.0 trajectory stack — the
pydantic `Trajectory` model and the static-analysis
`validate_trajectory` gate — so a schema drift on either side fails the
bench-script gate the workflows run (bench-tests.yml installs the pinned
harbor; the test skips when harbor is not importable, e.g. a bare dev
box).

Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s bench/harbor_fa
"""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

_FIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / "atif_sample.json"

try:
    from harbor.models.trajectories.trajectory import Trajectory
    from harbor.utils.trajectory_validator import validate_trajectory

    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised on bare dev boxes
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = False


@unittest.skipUnless(
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE,
    "harbor not importable (install 'harbor[modal]==0.23.0' as the "
    "bench workflows do)",
)
class AtifFixtureContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The Dart exporter's golden output must satisfy harbor's model and
    the leaderboard-style static validator."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.data = json.loads(_FIXTURE.read_text())

    def test_fixture_parses_as_atif_trajectory(self):
        trajectory = Trajectory(**self.data)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.schema_version, "ATIF-v1.7")
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.agent.name, "fa")
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.steps), 7)
        # Step ids are sequential from 1 (the model enforces it too).
        self.assertEqual(
            [s.step_id for s in trajectory.steps], list(range(1, 8))
        )

    def test_fixture_passes_the_static_analysis_validator(self):
        self.assertTrue(validate_trajectory(self.data))

    def test_tool_steps_are_deterministic_dispatches(self):
        tool_steps = [
            s for s in self.data["steps"] if "tool_calls" in s
        ]
        self.assertTrue(tool_steps)
        for step in tool_steps:
            self.assertEqual(step["llm_call_count"], 0)
            self.assertNotIn("metrics", step)
            self.assertNotIn("reasoning_content", step)
            self.assertIn("message", step)  # required on every step

    def test_non_agent_steps_carry_no_agent_only_fields(self):
        for step in self.data["steps"]:
            if step["source"] == "agent":
                continue
            for key in (
                "model_name",
                "metrics",
                "tool_calls",
                "reasoning_content",
                "llm_call_count",
            ):
                self.assertNotIn(key, step, f"{key} on {step['source']} step")

    def test_final_metrics_totals_match_the_steps(self):
        metrics = self.data["final_metrics"]
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_steps"], len(self.data["steps"]))
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_prompt_tokens"], 100)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_completion_tokens"], 20)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_cached_tokens"], 30)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: harbor-job-shard-${{ matrix.i }}

      - name: Tear down bench containers + output dir (gh-1600)

          ENV_TYPE: ${{ matrix.env }}
          KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}

          shopt -s nullglob

class SubmissionPreflightWiringTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681: leaderboard submission readiness wiring.

    - the `submission` dispatch input exists, boolean, OFF by default
      (AC4: no change to default bench behavior);
    - the setup job gains a submission preflight (full coverage, >=5
      attempts/task, no agent-timeout override, pinned dataset) gated on
      that input;
    - each shard gains an ATIF presence gate before the hub upload
      (warn-only normally, hard failure in submission mode);
    - the hub upload step itself keeps its secret-gated always-skip
      shape.
    """

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.text = _HARBOR_YML.read_text()
        setup_end = cls.text.index("\n  bench:")
        cls.setup_job = cls.text[:setup_end]
        cls.bench_job = cls.text[setup_end:cls.text.index("\n  summary:")]

    def test_submission_input_is_boolean_off_by_default(self):
        block = self.text.split("submission:", 1)[1]
        block = block.split("\n      ", 3)[0:3]
        joined = "\n      ".join(block)
        self.assertIn("type: boolean", joined)
        self.assertIn("default: false", joined)

    def test_setup_preflight_is_submission_gated(self):
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", self.setup_job)
        self.assertIn("Leaderboard submission preflight", self.setup_job)
        # The preflight must run BEFORE the bundle build / shard split
        # (it is part of the setup job at all) and enforce every rule.
        for rule in (
            "full task coverage",
            "attempts >= 5",
            "timeout_multiplier 1.0",
            "org/name@ref",
        ):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.setup_job)

    def test_atif_gate_sits_before_the_hub_upload(self):
        self.assertIn("Preflight ATIF trajectories", self.bench_job)
        self.assertLess(
            self.bench_job.index("Preflight ATIF trajectories"),
            self.bench_job.index("Upload to Harbor Hub"),
        )
        gate = self.bench_job.split("Preflight ATIF trajectories", 1)[1]
        gate = gate.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[0]
        # Warn-only normally; submission mode fails hard; the scan covers
        # agent/trajectory.json per trial dir with a result.json.
        self.assertIn('SUBMISSION: ${{ inputs.submission }}', gate)
        self.assertIn("agent/trajectory.json", gate)
        self.assertIn("exit 1", gate)

    def test_hub_upload_stays_secret_gated_and_public(self):
        upload = self.bench_job.split("Upload to Harbor Hub", 1)[1]
        upload = upload.split("- name:", 1)[0]
        self.assertIn("if: always() && env.HARBOR_API_KEY != ''", upload)
        self.assertIn("harbor upload", upload)
        self.assertIn("--public", upload)

    def test_default_dispatch_has_no_submission_side_effects(self):
        # AC4: without submission=true the only new behavior is the
        # always-on warn-only ATIF scan; the preflight step must not run.
        preflight = self.setup_job.split("Leaderboard submission preflight", 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(preflight), 2)
        self.assertIn("if: inputs.submission == true", preflight[1][:200])

{"newText":"    # ── gh-1681 Gap 2: ATIF trajectory export ─────────────────────────────

    async def _export_atif_trajectory(self, environment) -> None:
        """Best-effort ATIF export to /logs/agent/trajectory.json.

        Harbor's upload packager stores that file as the trial's
        trajectory_path and the leaderboard static analysis rejects
        rewarded trials without one; harbor does not build it for
        installed agents. The export rides the in-container fa CLI (the
        whole-snapshot exporter in lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart via
        `fa trajectory export`), so the conversion logic lives in ONE
        place (Dart) and the raw session JSONL stays the only input.

        Never raises: a failed/wedged export degrades to a loud stderr
        warning and populate_context_post_run's atif_trajectory metadata
        records the miss — the trial's own outcome is untouched.
        """
        command = (
            f"fa --session-root {_SESSION_ROOT} trajectory export "
            "--format atif --output /logs/agent/trajectory.json"
        )
        try:
            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self.exec_as_agent(
                    environment, command=command,
                    timeout_sec=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC,
                ),
                timeout=_ATIF_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SEC + 15,
            )
            if result.return_code != 0:
                tail = (result.stdout or "")[-200:]
                print(
                    f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export exited "
                    f"{result.return_code} (leaderboard static analysis "
                    f"needs agent/trajectory.json): {tail}",
                    file=sys.stderr,
                    flush=True,
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            print(
                f"[fa_agent] warning: ATIF trajectory export failed "
                f"(leaderboard static analysis needs agent/trajectory.json): "
                f"{exc}",
                file=sys.stderr,
                flush=True,
            )

class AtifExportTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """gh-1681 Gap 2: run() exports the ATIF trajectory on EVERY terminal
    path (completion / self-kill / crash / external cancel) via a bounded
    best-effort exec — the leaderboard static analysis requires
    <trial>/agent/trajectory.json on every rewarded trial and harbor does
    not build it for installed agents. Export failures degrade to a loud
    warning and the atif_trajectory metadata, never masking the trial's
    own outcome.
    """

    def _knob_env(self, **overrides):
        env = _clean_env(
            FA_AGENT_TIMEOUT_SEC="1",
            FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG=json.dumps({"apiKeyEnvVar": "FA_KEY_FAKE"}),
            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",
            **overrides,
        )
        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)

    def _export_calls(self, agent):
        return [c for c in agent.agent_calls if "trajectory export" in c]

    def test_completion_path_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            asyncio.run(agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None))
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        exports = self._export_calls(agent)
        self.assertEqual(len(exports), 1, agent.agent_calls)
        self.assertIn(_EXPORT_SNIPPET, exports[0])
        # The export names the session root the launch command uses.
        self.assertIn("fa --session-root /logs/agent/fah-sessions", exports[0])

    def test_self_kill_timeout_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with mock.patch.object(
            fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressWatch", _FastWatch
        ), mock.patch.object(fa_agent._timeout, "ProgressLadder", _FastWatch):
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.TimeoutError):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "agent_timeout")
        # The kill lands BEFORE the export (the trajectory must reflect
        # the final ledger, not a live one).
        kill_idx = next(
            i for i, c in enumerate(agent.root_calls) if "pkill" in c
        )
        launch_kinds = [
            ("agent", c) for c in agent.agent_calls
        ] + [("root", c) for c in agent.root_calls]
        last_kill_order = max(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds) if "pkill" in c
        )
        export_order = next(
            i for i, (_, c) in enumerate(launch_kinds)
            if "trajectory export" in c
        )
        self.assertGreater(export_order, last_kill_order)
        self.assertIsNotNone(kill_idx)

    def test_external_cancel_still_exports_atif(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()

        async def scenario():
            task = asyncio.create_task(
                agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            task.cancel()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task

        asyncio.run(scenario())
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "external_kill")
        self.assertEqual(len(self._export_calls(agent)), 1)

    def test_export_failure_is_loud_but_never_fails_the_trial(self):
        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent(
            launch_delay=0.05, export_error=RuntimeError("fa export wedged")
        )
        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export failed", err.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("leaderboard static analysis", err.getvalue())

    def test_export_nonzero_exit_warns(self):
        self._knob_env()

        class _FailedResult:
            return_code = 3
            stdout = "boom"

        agent = FakeAgent(launch_delay=0.05)
        real_exec = agent.exec_as_agent

        async def scripted(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            if "trajectory export" in command:
                return _FailedResult()
            return await real_exec(environment, command=command, env=env,
                                   timeout_sec=timeout_sec)

        err = io.StringIO()
        with mock.patch.object(fa_agent, "_POLL_SEC", 0.05):
            with contextlib.redirect_stderr(err), mock.patch.object(
                agent, "exec_as_agent", side_effect=scripted,
                autospec=True,
            ):
                asyncio.run(
                    agent.run("task", environment=object(), context=None)
                )
        self.assertEqual(agent._run_outcome, "completed")
        self.assertIn("ATIF trajectory export exited 3", err.getvalue())

    def test_populate_context_marks_atif_trajectory_presence(self):
        import tempfile

        self._knob_env()
        agent = FakeAgent()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            agent.logs_dir = Path(tmp)
            (Path(tmp) / "fah-sessions").mkdir()
            context = types.SimpleNamespace(metadata=None)
            agent.populate_context_post_run(context)
            self.assertEqual(
                context.metadata["atif_trajectory"], "missing"
            )
            (Path(tmp) / "trajectory.json").write_text("{}")
            context2 = types.SimpleNamespace(metadata=None)
            agent.populate_context_post_run(context2)
            self.assertEqual(
                context2.metadata["atif_trajectory"], "present"
            )
            # The failure-mode fold is untouched by the new flag.
            self.assertEqual(
                context2.metadata["failure_mode"], "never_started"
            )

            FA_KEY_FAKE="secret",

        env.start()
        self.addCleanup(env.stop)
        agent = FakeAgent()
        calls = []

        async def fake_exec(environment, command=None, env=None, timeout_sec=None):
            calls.append((command, env))
            return _ExecResult()

        agent.exec_as_agent = fake_exec
        asyncio.run(agent.run("instruction", object(), {}))
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertNotIn("FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS", calls[0][1])

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""gh-1681 Gap 2 — the ATIF fixture contract, validated from the harbor side.

`bench/harbor_fa/fixtures/atif_sample.json` is the GOLDEN output of the
Dart exporter (`lib/src/trajectory/atif_export.dart`, pinned by
test/trajectory/atif_export_test.dart). This test loads the same bytes and
validates them against the REAL harbor 0.23.0 trajectory stack — the
pydantic `Trajectory` model and the static-analysis
`validate_trajectory` gate — so a schema drift on either side fails the
bench-script gate the workflows run (bench-tests.yml installs the pinned
harbor; the test skips when harbor is not importable, e.g. a bare dev
box).

Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s bench/harbor_fa
"""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

_FIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / "atif_sample.json"

try:
    from harbor.models.trajectories.trajectory import Trajectory
    from harbor.utils.trajectory_validator import validate_trajectory

    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised on bare dev boxes
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE = False


@unittest.skipUnless(
    _HARBOR_AVAILABLE,
    "harbor not importable (install 'harbor[modal]==0.23.0' as the "
    "bench workflows do)",
)
class AtifFixtureContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """The Dart exporter's golden output must satisfy harbor's model and
    the leaderboard-style static validator."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.data = json.loads(_FIXTURE.read_text())

    def test_fixture_parses_as_atif_trajectory(self):
        trajectory = Trajectory(**self.data)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.schema_version, "ATIF-v1.7")
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.agent.name, "fa")
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.steps), 7)
        # Step ids are sequential from 1 (the model enforces it too).
        self.assertEqual(
            [s.step_id for s in trajectory.steps], list(range(1, 8))
        )

    def test_fixture_passes_the_static_analysis_validator(self):
        self.assertTrue(validate_trajectory(self.data))

    def test_tool_steps_are_deterministic_dispatches(self):
        tool_steps = [
            s for s in self.data["steps"] if "tool_calls" in s
        ]
        self.assertTrue(tool_steps)
        for step in tool_steps:
            self.assertEqual(step["llm_call_count"], 0)
            self.assertNotIn("metrics", step)
            self.assertNotIn("reasoning_content", step)
            self.assertIn("message", step)  # required on every step

    def test_non_agent_steps_carry_no_agent_only_fields(self):
        for step in self.data["steps"]:
            if step["source"] == "agent":
                continue
            for key in (
                "model_name",
                "metrics",
                "tool_calls",
                "reasoning_content",
                "llm_call_count",
            ):
                self.assertNotIn(key, step, f"{key} on {step['source']} step")

    def test_final_metrics_totals_match_the_steps(self):
        metrics = self.data["final_metrics"]
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_steps"], len(self.data["steps"]))
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_prompt_tokens"], 100)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_completion_tokens"], 20)
        self.assertEqual(metrics["total_cached_tokens"], 30)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
